method: Superforecasting pipeline (Tetlock & Gardner 2015) + scenario_calibrate. Base rates from reference-class analysis. Sub-question Fermi decomposition. Shrinkage toward base rate applied by scenario_calibrate. Brier loop open — forecast_record to be called when each horizon passes.

forecasts.question: Will MWG trade at fwd P/E > 15x before 31-Dec-2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: MWG HOSE closing fwd P/E above 15x on any trading day before 31-Dec-2027
forecasts.falsifier: VND depreciation or China import cost spike compresses margins → growth premium disappears
forecasts.engel_link: Vietnam transition zone (83% exit by 2030); MWG captures durables/electronics budget share shift (eta=1.15)

forecasts.question: Will Yduqs FCF grow > 20% pa for both FY2026 and FY2027, with no major FIES cut?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Yduqs investor-relations FCF figure > 20% YoY in both FY2026 and FY2027 annual reports, AND no FIES cut/cap announcement by Brazilian government before 31-Dec-2027

key_sub_questions.q: No major FIES cut by end-2027

forecasts.falsifier: FIES cut → enrollment drops → FCF growth collapses; OR debt refinancing at higher rates compresses FCF
forecasts.engel_link: Brazil post-transition (food 16.2%); first-generation university access is the post-Engel education thesis (effective eta >> 0.97 for this cohort)

forecasts.question: Will GGAL trade above 1.5x book value before 31-Dec-2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: GGAL Nasdaq ADR closing P/B above 1.5x (per Morningstar or Yahoo Finance) on any trading day before 31-Dec-2027
forecasts.falsifier: Milei macro programme fails → inflation returns → GGAL earnings collapse in USD → stays below book
forecasts.engel_link: Argentina GDP post-transition (eta=1.37 for financial services) but macro overwhelms Engel mechanism; this is primarily a macro-stabilisation trade, Engel is secondary
